# Code of conduct

Dnyx Academy repositories, pull requests and discussions are a place to learn. Beginners are the
point, not an inconvenience.

## What we expect

- Be respectful and patient. Everyone here is at the start of something.
- Give feedback on the work, not the person. Say what to change and why.
- Assume the question is honest. "Read the docs" is not an answer.
- Keep it in English where you can, so the whole batch can follow, and use whatever language you
  need to be understood.

## What is not acceptable

- Personal attacks, harassment, or discrimination of any kind, including on caste, religion,
  gender, disability, language or region.
- Sexual language or imagery.
- Posting someone's private information.
- Sustained disruption of sessions, chats or reviews.
- Plagiarism, or pressuring someone to share work meant to be their own.

## Reporting

Tell your mentor, or raise a support ticket in Dnyx Learn. For anything you would rather not put to
a mentor, use the contact form at [dnyxacademy.com/contact](https://dnyxacademy.com/contact) and say
it is a conduct report.

Reports are read by the lead trainer. We will tell you what we decided. Consequences range from a
private word to removal from the programme.
